about.en: GOATED is the token of GOAT Network, a Bitcoin Layer 2 that uses zero-knowledge proofs, decentralized sequencing and a BitVM2-based bridge to settle execution against Bitcoin. Gas on the network is paid in BTC; GOATED is the ecosystem and incentive token, distributed alongside BTC-denominated fees as yield from protocol activity. It circulates as a BEP-20 on BNB Smart Chain and an ERC-20 on Ethereum, both at 0x5d7909f951436d4e6974d841316057df3a622962.
